name: Shopify tracker - Drive to SERVER DB (v2)

parameters.content:
## Drive to Postgres, entirely inside n8n

Press **Execute Workflow**. It finds today's dated
folder inside `Shopify_Scraper_CsvFiles`, matches
every CSV in it to a store, and ingests them one
by one.

### What changed from the old version

**1 - It reads the dated subfolder.**
The old query looked only at the parent folder and
excluded folders, so it found the `Shopify_Scraper`
Sheet and none of the CSVs. It ingested nothing.

**2 - `run_date` is the folder name.**
It used to come from the filename, falling back to
Drive's `modifiedTime` - which dates anything
uploaded after midnight to the next day.

**3 - One bad file no longer ends the run.**
Download, parse and ingest each have an error
output. A failure is written down and the loop
moves on to the next store.

**4 - The parser was truncated.**
The copy in this folder cut off mid-statement and
could not run at all. This one is the complete
node from `tracker/n8n/drive-to-db.json`.

### Two credentials

**Google Drive OAuth2** - must be a *Web
application* client. The one in
`tracker/secure/client_secrets.json` is a Desktop
app and will not work here.

**Postgres** - this must be the **company server's**
database, the same one `npm run ingest:server`
writes to.

> The server's Postgres listens on **localhost
> only**. If n8n does not run on that server this
> workflow cannot reach it: you need an SSH tunnel,
> or n8n moved onto the server.

### Before the first run

The database needs `ingest_store_day()`.

parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'stores', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
                'id', id, 'name', name, 'csv_prefix', csv_prefix)), '[]'::json)
               FROM stores WHERE active),
  'done',   (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(store_id || '|' || to_char(run_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), '[]'::json)
               FROM scrape_runs WHERE status IN ('success','partial'))
) AS meta

nodes.name: Parse CSV and build the ingest

parameters.content:
### Error handling

Three nodes have an error output wired to
**Record the failure**: the download, the parser
and the ingest. Whatever goes wrong for one file,
the loop continues with the next store, and the
Summary names what failed and why - on one line.

`Run ingest_store_day` retries once before giving
up, because a dropped connection is worth another
go. The parser is not retried: a CSV that fails to
parse will fail the same way again.

### Only new work

A store+date already recorded as `success` or
`partial` is skipped, so running twice is harmless.
Set `FORCE = true` in **Decide what to ingest** to
replay a day - but only a store's newest date can
be replayed.

### Unmatched files are named, never guessed at

A CSV whose name matches no store's `csv_prefix`
is listed in the Summary and left alone.

### The diff is not in this workflow

`ingest_store_day()` does it, which is why ~2% of
rows are written each night instead of a full
snapshot - and why n8n and `scripts/ingest.mjs`
produce identical history.

### Nothing to do?

If no CSV is new the loop never runs, so the
Summary never fires. Read the log of **Decide what
to ingest** - it says exactly what it found.

### Files stay on Drive

Drive is at 98%. Add a Google Drive -> Delete File
node after **Run ingest_store_day** once you trust
it: the database is the archive.
